Lina G: Flagged by bank: dispute opened for txn ch_5Zr2K on acct scaleup-co for $18,750.00. Reason: cardholder claims fraudulent and duplicate. Stripe dispute id dp_5Zr2K. Need evidence pack + decision on hold by EOD.
Marco F: Can you drop invoice number, descriptor, and last4? Also any prior risk flags for this BIN?
Lina G: Invoice INV-2027-01-22-801. Descriptor REDWOOD*INFER. Last4 2468. BIN has 2 low-severity alerts last quarter.
billing-bot: webhook received wh_20270122_6741 txn=ch_5Zr2K amount=1875000 currency=usd status=disputed
Jules R: Quick triage: was 3DS attempted? device fingerprint? capture vs authorize timestamps?
Lina G: 3DS not required (merchant-level off for this customer). Device fingerprint ID df_77a9 saved. Two captures present: capture_1 at 2027-01-22T11:05:02Z and capture_2 at 11:05:05Z. Looks like near-instant retry. Uploading logs.
Marco F: Put account on temporary billing hold and alert AM. Also check if customer requested expedited provisioning (could explain duplicate activities).
CS Lead: Notified AM and sent holding message to customer: "We're investigating your billing inquiry". Email copy attached to ticket.
Jules R: Need AVS/ZIP result, IP geo, and any tokenization token history. Also include order payload and any server retry logs.
Lina G: AVS=N (zip mismatch), IPs: 52.54.121.9 (ap-southeast-2) and 18.204.10.44 (us-east-1). Tokenization shows token reused across two merchant sessions; client_request_id different but payload identical.
Marco F: Strategy: we can argue duplicate merchant capture and merchant error. But cardholder alleges fraud; include proof of delivery (email/keys) and CS confirmation of receipt if present.
Lina G: CS note: customer reached out saying they did NOT authorize two charges. They acknowledge one charge but dispute duplicate. Attaching transcript.
Jules R: Also check if the reseller flow was involved or if this was direct. If reseller, include their invoice and communication.
Lina G: Direct. No reseller. Evidence bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/disputes/dp_5Zr2K/evidence_bundle_v1.zip (includes timeline.csv, logs, invoice, email headers, device_fingerprint.json).
billing-bot: Dispute status updated -> needs_response. response_due 2027-01-29
Marco F: I'll draft representment arguing duplicate merchant capture + delivery confirmation. Will request Stripe to reverse one charge only. If Stripe rules for cardholder on fraud, finance to process reversal and start loss reserve flow.
CS Lead: Keep me posted; I'll prep customer-facing note if we need to issue a refund.
Jules R: Also recommend adding temporary 3DS enforcement for new high-value accounts until dispute closed. Marking as risk: high_velocity.
Lina G: Thanks team. Submitting draft now and moving follow-ups into the dispute ticket dp_5Zr2K. Closing Slack thread here. :white_check_mark:
